name: repoweave
description: Generate a repository-aware agent harness for Copilot, Claude, and Codex. A guided studio analyzes the repo, previews every file, and writes only after you confirm.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: RepoWeave reads repository files and writes reviewed agent configuration in trusted local workspaces.

commands.title: RepoWeave: Analyze Selected Files with AI
RepoWeave: Connect Azure DevOps or Jira

walkthroughs.title: Create an agent harness
walkthroughs.description: Analyze this repository and write agents, skills, and instructions for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Codex.

steps.title: Open the studio
steps.description:
Open an Angular or React folder and trust the workspace.
[Open Harness Studio](command:repoweave.open)
The studio highlights the next step. The status bar shows the same step.

steps.title: Choose your coding assistant
steps.description:
Pick GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or more than one.
[Choose Coding Assistants](command:repoweave.targets)
Preview again after you change this. Hooks and the agent-name prefix live in Settings.

steps.title: Generate and review the files
steps.description:
You confirm once before any file is written. Click a proposed file in the studio to see the before and after.
[Generate Harness (All Steps)](command:repoweave.run)

steps.title: Review architecture in your assistant
steps.description:
Copy a prompt and paste it into your coding assistant. It should write `.repoweave/semantic.json`. Preview again so the harness picks up those facts.
[Copy Architecture Review Prompt](command:repoweave.bootstrap)

repoweave.targets.description: Clients to generate harness files for. Multi-client output uses shared skills to avoid duplicate discovery.

repoweave.includeHooks.description: Include a read-only profile freshness hook for supported hosts. Preview the command before applying.

repoweave.maxSourceFiles.description: Maximum first-party source files analyzed per scan. Omitted files are reported.

repoweave.agentPrefix.description: Prefix for generated agent, skill, prompt and scoped instruction names. Empty derives a slug from the root package name, then the folder name, then project.
